name: Laser Systems and Applications
description: Review of laser theory, properties of laser radiation, and laser safety; CW lasers systems, DPSS lasers, fiber lasers, gas lasers, pulsed lasers: ns, ps, fs and attosecond lasers, excimer and dye-lasers; semiconductor lasers: DH, QW, QCL, VCSEL, DFB and DBR lasers. Application of lasers in data storage, communication and information technology; laser applications in optical metrology; surface profile and dimensional measurements; laser applications in material processing and manufacturing; 3D-printing, marking, drilling, cutting, welding, hardening and manufacturing; laser doppler velocimetry, LIDAR, laser spectroscopy, LIF, LIBS, bio-medical applications of lasers, laser applications in precision agriculture, laser tweezers and applications, laser applications in defense and security.
